t.E959.agn: In its 2022 re-evaluation, EFSA raised the acceptable daily intake (ADI) from 5 mg/kg, set by the SCF in 1989, to 20 mg/kg body weight. Estimated intake remained well below this limit in all age groups.
t.E959.body: According to animal studies, it is absorbed into the body, and it and its breakdown products are excreted mainly in the urine.
t.E959.prod: Produced by catalytic hydrogenation of neohesperidin obtained from citrus fruits.
t.E959.regx.0: Re-evaluated; ADI raised from 5 to 20 mg/kg.
t.E959.summary: An intense sweetener produced from a substance obtained from citrus fruits. Also used to mask bitterness.
t.E959.what: An intense sweetener produced by processing a substance obtained from bitter orange.
